answer: Make each epoch begin at dawn, when every identity must publish a fresh seed that was unknown the night before, so no head can pre-mine a stack of dormant accounts and wake them later. A prism then bends that seed into three separate channels, each read by a different peer set that never sees the other two, so a cluster controlling one channel still cannot forge a consistent triple. Standing is frozen into tundra: history that stops moving calcifies and cannot be revived for credit, which forces every clone to keep paying full participation cost in the open.
